_comment: Per-deployable wasm size budgets in bytes. The gate fails when an artifact grows past baseline_bytes + tolerance_percent, or crosses absolute_ceiling_bytes (Stellar's on-chain contractMaxSizeBytes, 131072 = 128 KiB, read from the network config setting CONFIG_SETTING_CONTRACT_MAX_SIZE_BYTES on both testnet and mainnet). Update via scripts/update-wasm-budgets.sh after intentional size changes.
_update_process: To update budgets: 1) Build every deployable (see DEPLOYABLE_ARTIFACTS.md), 2) Run 'bash scripts/update-wasm-budgets.sh' to refresh baseline_bytes from the built artifacts, 3) Review the diff and commit with the rationale in your PR description.
_inventory: Every deployable wasm in DEPLOYABLE_ARTIFACTS.md must have an entry here. scripts/check-wasm-budgets.sh reads this file and the report in .github/workflows/wasm-size-budget.yml covers all entries.

bounty_escrow.description: Bounty escrow contract (DEPLOYABLE_ARTIFACTS.md: Deployed). Budget raised from 319488 -> 352256 (+32768 B) in issue #1882 to accommodate the analytics/monitoring surface: get_escrow_count, query_escrows_by_status, query_escrows_by_depositor, get_escrow_ids_by_status, updated query_escrows_by_amount, updated query_escrows_by_deadline (now return Vec<EscrowWithId>) and their paginate_escrows_with_id helper.

soroban_escrow.description: Legacy Soroban escrow contract (DEPLOYABLE_ARTIFACTS.md: Superseded). Built from the soroban/ workspace with `cargo build -p escrow --target wasm32v1-none --release`; baseline measured at 64735 bytes.
